hero: A pediatric nephrology clinic in Batangas: a round-faced 10-year-old Filipino girl in glasses sits between her parents, looking down shyly, while a pediatric nephrologist lays three plain option cards on the desk and speaks directly to her. A growth chart is pinned on the wall behind. Warm daylight, no text.

figures.teaches: Steroid-sensitive, non-genetic resistant and genetic resistant disease differ in mechanism, treatment response and transplant recurrence.
figures.content: Three columns. 'Steroid-sensitive, relapsing': icon of antibodies at the podocyte; 'Remits with steroids'; 'Steroid-sparing helps'. 'Resistant, non-genetic': antibodies or circulating factor; 'CNI first-line'; 'Recurrence 25.8%'. 'Resistant, genetic': broken podocyte protein; 'Immunosuppression rarely helps'; 'Recurrence 4.5%'. Footer 'PodoNet registry; genetic cause 23.6% of screened'.

figures.teaches: Several steroid-sparing agents have evidence; the choice weighs harms, routine and cost with the family.
figures.content: Five rows: 'Levamisole: HR 0.22; neutropenia'; 'MMF: oral, no nephrotoxicity'; 'CNI: levels, creatinine'; 'Cyclophosphamide: single course, fertility'; 'Rituximab: 267 vs 101 days; infection'. Right column icons for 'Cost', 'Blood tests', 'Infusion'. Footer 'Decide with the family; doses from formulary'.

card: A girl in glasses sitting between her parents as a doctor lays out three option cards on a desk.
